headline: Five Senior Police Officials Get New Posts in Latest PNP Reorganization
seoTitle: Five Senior PNP Officials Reassigned | FMB News
seoDescription: Five senior police officials received new assignments in the latest Philippine National Police reorganization.
keywords: PNP Maritime Group Highway Patrol Group
deck: The changes included new acting leadership for the Maritime Group, Highway Patrol Group and PNP training posts.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Five senior Philippine National Police officials received new assignments in a reorganization that took effect on August 29 and was reported over the National Heroes Day weekend.

Brig. Gen. Rommel Batangan, formerly head of the Highway Patrol Group, became acting director of the Maritime Group, while Brig. Gen. Joyce Patrick Sangalang was assigned to lead the Highway Patrol Group.

sections.heading: Other assignments
paragraphs: Brig. Gen. Francisco Ebreo was assigned as acting director of the training service, Brig. Gen. Roland Bulalacao moved to the PNP Academy, and Col. Renell Sabaldica was reassigned as executive officer of the Directorate for Comptrollership.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The changes followed a broader round of senior-level police transfers involving regional and national support units.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: Leadership changes in operational groups can affect priorities in maritime security, highway enforcement, training and internal administration.
